verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a widely used CLI and library tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside FFmpeg. Users instead turn to external LLMs, GUIs or the man page to build commands, which is a user-side workaround. The Whisper transcription discussion is about a media-processing feature, not an assistant you delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
